description: Only created shared-source RisingWave CDC tables from catalog membership. Lag is source timestamp to reader processing, not current backlog or destination visibility. Identical upstream names are distinguished by source-scoped CDC identity. Idle mapped tables remain listed; missing/insufficient lag observations are explicitly unavailable. Dropped tables disappear after the metadata refresh and scrape. Requires meta and compute nodes exporting cdc_table_info and cdc_table_id lag labels.

targets.expr: (((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cdc_table_id) (rate(source_cdc_event_lag_duration_milliseconds_bucket{server=~"${server:regex}",kubernetes_namespace="risingwave",risingwave_name="risingwave",cdc_table_id!=""}[${interval}]))) / 1000) == (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cdc_table_id) (rate(source_cdc_event_lag_duration_milliseconds_bucket{server=~"${server:regex}",kubernetes_namespace="risingwave",risingwave_name="risingwave",cdc_table_id!=""}[${interval}]))) / 1000)) * on (cdc_table_id) group_right() (max by (cdc_table_id, table_id, database, schema, table_name) (cdc_table_info{server=~"${server:regex}",kubernetes_namespace="risingwave",risingwave_name="risingwave"}))) or on (table_id) ((((sum by (cdc_table_id) (increase(source_cdc_event_lag_duration_milliseconds_count{server=~"${server:regex}",kubernetes_namespace="risingwave",risingwave_name="risingwave",cdc_table_id!=""}[${interval}]))) == 0) * 0 - 1) * on (cdc_table_id) group_right() (max by (cdc_table_id, table_id, database, schema, table_name) (cdc_table_info{server=~"${server:regex}",kubernetes_namespace="risingwave",risingwave_name="risingwave"}))) or on (table_id) ((max by (cdc_table_id, table_id, database, schema, table_name) (cdc_table_info{server=~"${server:regex}",kubernetes_namespace="risingwave",risingwave_name="risingwave"})) * 0 - 2)
